svg.title: How one node becomes poses and neighbour slots
svg.desc: Animated: node 8 (headings [0, 90], rotation allowed) and node 9 (heading [90]) from the Pecos YAML, their poses after GetAllowedHeadings, an AGV at each pose, and the eight PoseNeighbor slots that pose_graph.cpp fills for them.
svg.metadata: ["Two YAML entries. Node 8 at (30.8823, 12.7753) lists headings [0, 90] and rotation_allowed true; node 9, 6.30 m to the east, lists [90] and may not rotate. Both are XL waypoints.", "GetAllowedHeadings (pose_utils.cpp) emits Wrap(h) and Wrap(h + 180) for every listed heading and sorts: node 8 gets four poses, -90, 0, 90, 180; node 9 gets two, -90 and 90. These are poses_[14..17] and poses_[18..19] of the 60 Pecos poses.", "What a heading means for the AGV. At (8, 90) the body +x axis, the AGV's long side and driving (locomote) axis, points west: heading 90 = facing west. Its right side (body -y) points north; moving sideways is a strafe. GeometricPose.yaw is the same angle in radians.", "The eight slots of (8, 90). For each layout neighbour with the same heading, pose_graph.cpp measures the bearing relative to the heading: 0 is FORWARD (W13, north), 180 BACK (W4), +90 LEFT (W31, west), -90 RIGHT (W9). Rotation: the nearest clockwise heading is ROT_RIGHT (8, 0), the nearest counter-clockwise is ROT_LEFT (8, 180). No VRC, so VRC_UP and VRC_DOWN stay empty (-1).", "The same node at heading -90: the AGV faces east, so every name flips. FORWARD is now W4, BACK W13, LEFT W9 and RIGHT W31; ROT_LEFT is (8, 0) and ROT_RIGHT (8, 180). The neighbours are the same nodes, reached through different slots.", "(8, 0) and (8, 180) are stepping stones. No neighbour of node 8 has heading 0 or 180, so these poses get rotation slots only. They turn a 90 to -90 flip into two 90-degree steps; without heading 0 in the YAML, ROT_LEFT and ROT_RIGHT would both be one 180-degree spin.", "The names describe the helper frame, not driving. FORWARD and BACK are travel out of the AGV's right and left sides: GarageGraph types them STRAFE. LEFT and RIGHT are along body +x and -x: LOCOMOTE, the AGV's normal driving. Node 9 shows it: (9, 90) FORWARD is the 0.61 m strafe north onto charger C10, LEFT is the drive west to W8; it has no rotation slots.", "Summary for Pecos: 26 nodes with one heading give 2 poses each, nodes 8 and 22 give 4: 60 poses and 480 slots, of which 164 are filled (148 translations, 16 rotations, no VRC). GarageGraph turns each filled slot into one directed edge."]
